description: Only transactions with an amount strictly greater than 2400 count, so an amount of exactly 2400 is excluded.

d.request: Group transactions with amount strictly greater than 2400 by operation (treating NULL operations as a separate group), and for each group report the operation, the average signed amount computed from PRIJEM transactions as positive and VYDAJ transactions as negative with other types excluded, and the total count of large transactions in that group of any type.
d.sql: SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) as avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) as transaction_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY operation

c.request: Treating 2400 as the cutoff for a large transaction amount (`trans.amount`), break the large transactions down by operation (`trans.operation`), with transactions that have no operation as their own group. For each group, show the operation; the average signed amount, positive for credits (`trans.type` = 'PRIJEM') and negative for withdrawals ('VYDAJ'), with any other type left out of the average; and how many large transactions the group has in total, of any type. Only transactions with an amount strictly greater than 2400 count, so an amount of exactly 2400 is excluded.
c.sql: SELECT trans.operation, AVG(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -trans.amount ELSE NULL END) as average_signed_amount, COUNT(*) as transaction_count FROM trans WHERE trans.amount > 2400 GROUP BY trans.operation ORDER BY trans.operation

b.request: Classify transactions with amount strictly greater than 2400 by operation (treating NULL operation as a separate group), and for each group report the operation, the average signed amount (positive for PRIJEM, negative for VYDAJ, excluding other types from average), and total count of transactions.
b.sql: SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) as count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY operation ORDER BY operation
b.raw: Classify transactions with amount strictly greater than 2400 by operation (treating NULL operation as a separate group), and for each group report the operation, the average signed amount (positive for PRIJEM, negative for VYDAJ, excluding other types from average), and total count of transactions.

a.request: Considering only transactions whose amount (`trans.amount`) is greater than 2400, group them by operation (`trans.operation`), with transactions that have no operation forming their own group. For each group, show the operation; the average signed amount, where the amount counts as positive for credits (`trans.type` = 'PRIJEM'), as negative for withdrawals (`trans.type` = 'VYDAJ'), and is left out of the average for any other type; and the total number of transactions in the group, of any type.
a.sql: SELECT trans.operation, AVG(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -trans.amount ELSE NULL END) as average_signed_amount, COUNT(*) as total_transactions FROM trans WHERE trans.amount > 2400 GROUP BY trans.operation
